text:
nina: Quick sync: rethinking the streaming UI for the playground. Main choices: (A) stop/regenerate as a single inline control cluster, (B) stop as primary inline + regenerate in overflow, (C) separate persistent regen action in the composer. Also token meter: persistent micro-badge vs auto-hide until hover vs overlay that expands. Prompt library: right flyout vs bottom sheet. Share brief takes + any a11y/copy concerns. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc-playground-streaming devon: My vote: inline cluster (A) but make Regenerate secondary and collapsed until Stop pressed. Users expect a single place to act on the current generation. :+1: lee: Accessibility: stop must be reachable by keyboard (Enter/Space) and announced when pressed. Use `aria-live=polite` for partial text updates and `aria-atomic=false` so screen readers don't re-read entire doc on each chunk. Example snippet: ```
``` Also suggest `prefers-reduced-motion` handling for any stream animation. pat: Token meter: prefer a micro-badge fixed to the top-right of the chat pane. Keep digits collapsed while streaming (e.g. show "~12" or "--") to avoid layout jump. On hover, expand to full tokens + estimated cost. We should show realtime token delta so user knows consumption. ara: Prompt library: right flyout is better on wide screens; bottom sheet works on small screens. Implement responsive pattern: flyout on width>900px, sheet otherwise. Keyboard flow: `Ctrl+K` opens library, focus to first item, Enter inserts prompt into composer. Each saved prompt needs `aria-label` and last-modified timestamp for context. nina: Copy question: we currently label the button `Stop`. Lee used `Interrupt` above. Which is clearer? Also what about tooltip text for expanded token meter? devon: I prefer `Interrupt` because it implies we might keep partial output. Tooltip for token meter: "Tokens used / est. cost (streaming)". Keep the meter low-contrast but accessible. lee: From a11y POV `Stop` is fine but ambiguous. `Interrupt` maps to keyboard wording (`interrupt` is common in terminals). If we use `Interrupt`, ensure tooltip says "Interrupt (pauses generation; partial result preserved)". pat: UX micro-interaction: when user hits Interrupt, show a tiny unobtrusive toast: "Generation interrupted — partial output saved. Regenerate to try again." Also add analytics event `ui.playground.interrupt` with fields: model, tokens_at_interrupt, warm_cache_possible:boolean. ara: On prompt library performance: lazy-load content and thumbnails; prefetch last-used prompts on open. Keyboard shortcut doc: add `?` quick help overlay listing `Ctrl+K`, `Ctrl+R` (regen), `Ctrl+.` (interrupt). devon: Engineering note: Regenerate should try to reuse cached KV if request metadata matches. If we expose `x-warm-cache: true` header in the response, UI can animate small speedup indicator. ui-bot: Reminder: prototype for design review due Tue 2026-04-05. Please attach working prototype + a11y checklist to PR. nina: Thanks everyone. Action items I recorded: 1) Prototype inline cluster with collapsed regen, 2) Micro token badge with hover expand + cost tooltip, 3) Responsive prompt library (flyout/sheet), 4) Add a11y notes (reduced motion, aria-live, keyboard focus), 5) Telemetry spec. Filing PR now — shout if anything else.
